description: Reads one MIDAS help-centre article in full, as Markdown: headings, notes, input tables, and for the MIDAS API manual the URI, methods, JSON schema and JSON examples as code blocks. Also lists the article's images (links). Long articles come in parts: call again with nextOffset. Give the user the article's url when you rely on it. Needs no model and no account.

id.description: Article id from midas_docs_search (e.g. "35987578396697") or the article's support.midasuser.com URL.

images.description: List the article's images (alt text and link).

offset.description: Character offset to start from (nextOffset of the previous call).

name: midas_docs_read
title: Read a MIDAS manual article
